-->

## Summary

<!-- What this PR does, in one or two sentences. -->

## Intent

<!-- The source of truth: a real URL or `#<issue number>`. Not "discussed offline". -->

## Scope

<!-- What is in this PR, and explicitly what is NOT. -->

## Verification

<!-- Commands run and their results. State what was not seen or verified. -->

## Screenshots / Evidence

<!-- Output, renders, or a note that this change has no visual surface. -->

## Risk Assessment

<!-- What can break, and how likely. -->

## AI Usage Declaration

<!-- At least one box must be ticked. A PR opened by an agent declares it. -->

- [ ] Code generated by AI, reviewed by a human
- [ ] Code written by a human, AI-assisted review
- [ ] Code written by a human without AI
- [ ] No AI involvement

## Reviewer Focus
